Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
Criterion: Given a registered member, when the POS sends one completed purchase event for that member, then a pending points transaction for that purchase and member exists.
Test idea: Send a sample purchase event in the S-02 JSON format to the event consumer; query the member's transactions; expect one Pending transaction that references the purchase ID.

Text: The loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Criterion: For purchase amounts SGD 0.00, 0.99, 1.00, 1.99 and 150.75 the awarded points are 0, 0, 1, 1 and 150.
Test idea: Table-driven test of the points calculation with these amounts (no campaign active).

Text: WHEN a pending points transaction is 24 hours old and the purchase was not returned, the loyalty service shall post the points to the member's balance.
Criterion: A pending transaction created at time T whose purchase is not returned is still pending at T + 23 h 59 min and posted at T + 24 h, with the balance raised by its points; one whose purchase is returned before T + 24 h is not posted.
Test idea: With a controllable clock, create a pending transaction at T and check its status and the balance at T + 23 h 59 min and T + 24 h; repeat with a return at T + 1 h.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the updated balance shall be available to the customer mobile app within TBD seconds.
Criterion: After the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the customer mobile app's balance request returns the updated balance within TBD seconds at the TBD percentile, under TBD balance requests per minute.
Test idea: Performance test: post points for a batch of test members and poll the balance endpoint; record the time from posting to updated balance and compare the agreed percentile with the target.
Question: How many seconds after posting must the new balance be visible, at which percentile and under what load? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: WHEN the cashier scans a voucher at the POS, the POS shall apply the voucher value as a discount to the open sale.
Criterion: On a TillPoint test till connected to the test loyalty service, scanning a valid voucher reduces the open sale total by the voucher value.
Test idea: Store-lab session with the POS vendor (SH-09) and store operations (SH-02) as witnesses; record the till screen before and after the scan for one valid voucher.

Text: WHEN a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, the admin console shall require approval by a second support agent before posting it.
Criterion: An adjustment of 5,001 points submitted by agent A stays unposted until a different agent B approves it; an adjustment of exactly 5,000 points posts without a second approval; agent A cannot approve their own adjustment.
Test idea: Admin console test with two test agent accounts: submit 5,000 and 5,001 points, check the posting and the approval queue, then try self-approval.

Text: The customer mobile app shall be intuitive.
Criterion: Proposed form: in a moderated usability test with TBD first-time members, at least TBD of them complete TBD task (for example redeeming a voucher) without help within TBD minutes.
Test idea: Moderated usability sessions on a prototype or a test build; count completions without help and time on task.
Question: Which tasks define 'intuitive' for the app, how many first-time members, and what completion rate and time count as a pass? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: WHILE the year-end sale peak is running, the loyalty service shall accept TBD purchase events per minute without losing an event.
Criterion: During a sustained load test at TBD purchase events per minute for TBD minutes, every event sent is stored as a pending points transaction (zero lost).
Test idea: Load test in a production-like environment replaying recorded purchase events; compare the count of events sent with transactions stored.
Question: What peak rate must the service accept, and for how long? Last year's peak was about 9,000 purchases per minute (Rationale); is the target that figure or higher for growth? (owner: SH-08 Wei Jie Chua)

Text: The loyalty service shall be available TBD % of each calendar month.
Criterion: For each calendar month, available minutes divided by total minutes, computed from monitoring data, is at least TBD %.
Test idea: Monthly analysis of the monitoring export during the pilot; a single test run cannot show monthly availability.
Question: What availability target applies, over all hours or opening hours only, and does planned maintenance count as downtime? (owner: SH-08 Wei Jie Chua)

Text: The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years after the transaction date.
Criterion: No points transaction record younger than 7 years is deleted by any retention or clean-up job.
Test idea: Run every clean-up job against back-dated records (7 years minus 1 day, and newer); all remain. Inspect the backup retention settings as a complement.

Text: The loyalty service shall not store payment card numbers.
Criterion: The database schema, the S-02 purchase event mapping and the log configuration contain no field that stores a payment card number, confirmed in a review by SH-05.
Test idea: Checklist review of schema migrations, event mapping and log masking rules; add a test that a purchase event carrying a card number is stored without it.
